en:
## New Features

- StructSed approval cards now show the diff that will be written, split into one hunk per changed region
- At low detail levels, a tool awaiting approval opens in place inside its activity trace instead of jumping out as a separate card, and the form's space is reserved from the first frame
- Cards now close smoothly when a tool finishes, reasoning is saved, or an approval is answered, instead of snapping shut
- Live reasoning rows show a "Thinking…" placeholder before any text arrives

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed tables becoming unreadable on upgraded databases because JSON columns were given an empty-string default; affected rows are repaired on startup
- Editing a message no longer silently drops its file references
- Compacting with no summary model configured now falls back to the default model instead of failing with an unclear error
- The input box's action buttons no longer cover the end of the text
- An approval row no longer briefly jumps back to "setting up" while its form is on screen
- Activity traces no longer remount (losing expand state) when a streaming turn is saved
- Custom TLS SANs save as you edit and prompt for re-signing when they differ from the current certificate
- Subagents that were taken over can receive messages again, and stop signals now cover every abort path
- Nested Codex WebSocket requests no longer disconnect the parent session
- Codex requests no longer send the installation id as an HTTP header, matching the official client

## Performance

- Loading history and file-modification lists on large narrators is up to several hundred times faster
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- StructSed 审批卡片会显示将要写入的 diff，并按改动区域分成多个 hunk
- 低细节层级下，等待审批的工具调用在活动轨迹内原位展开，不再跳出成单独卡片；表单占位从第一帧就预留好
- 工具完成、推理落盘、审批答复后，卡片会平滑收起，不再瞬间消失
- 实时推理行在还没有文字时显示「思考中…」占位

## 修复

- 修复升级后的数据库中 JSON 列默认值被写成空串、导致整张表读不出来的问题；启动时会自动修复受损行
- 编辑消息时不再悄悄丢掉文件引用
- 未配置摘要模型时，压缩会回落到默认模型，不再报出难以理解的错误
- 输入框右侧按钮不再压住文字末尾
- 审批表单显示期间，审批行不再短暂退回「准备中」
- 流式回合落盘时活动轨迹不再重新挂载、丢失展开状态
- TLS 自定义 SAN 编辑即保存，与当前证书不一致时会提示重签
- 被接管的子代理可以正常接收消息，停止信号覆盖所有中止路径
- Codex 嵌套 WebSocket 请求不再把父会话挤掉线
- Codex 请求不再把安装 ID 作为 HTTP 头发送，与官方客户端一致

## 性能优化

- 大型叙述者的历史加载和文件修改列表最多快数百倍
